text: 4 We go together. For the Teacher : • Distribute capital and small letter cards to the children. • Ask a child to come forward, show his/her card to the class and tell its sound. • Ask the child having card with the same sound to stand next to him/her. • When all the letter cards are matched, the game will be over. For the Teacher : • Ask the children to name the pictures. • Stress the sound of middle letter of each word. • Help the children to find the way to Bela’s home. 3. Follow the words with ‘e’ sound in the middle to help Bela reach her home. Start Bela Bela’s Home 2. Look, listen and follow.
